info.title: PaddyGuard AI — API Gateway
info.description: Central gateway for all PaddyGuard AI microservices

post.description:
Forward audio file to C1 voice_nlp service for diagnosis.

Timeout is generous: the first Whisper ASR call after a cold start can
take several minutes before the model is warm.
Forward follow-up answer to C1 for continued diagnosis.
Forward chat message to C4 RAG chatbot.

get.description: Forward to C4's GET /chat/topics — the scoped disease/pest list the frontend renders as suggestion chips.

delete.description: Forward to C4's DELETE /chat/session/:sessionId — used when the user starts a new chat.
